The demospipes addon images are the ones meant to run. Let me check whether addon images contain their app code properly. Let me look at the addon-api image - does it have demospipes_api installed? Let me verify by running it.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker rm -f val-addapi 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name val-addapi -p 18003:8000 demospipes-addon-bmds-api:latest >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 12; docker inspect --format 'State={{.State.Status}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}}' val-addapi; for p in /docs /openapi.json; do printf "%-14s " "$p"; curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:18003$p; done; docker logs val-addapi 2>&1 | tail -12
